system_type_reason: End-user autonomous penetration-testing agent with TUI client.

repo_overview.summary: Autonomous local penetration-testing agent: a self-hosted Ollama LLM drives a RECON -> ANALYSIS -> EXPLOIT -> REPORT pipeline, executing tools inside a Kali Linux Docker sandbox plus browser automation, a custom fuzzer, native Caido proxy integration, Semgrep and a local SQLite knowledge base. A Textual TUI is the client; it talks to a FastAPI proxy server that hosts the AgentLoop. Fully offline, no API keys. The loop runs periodic checkpoints (phase eval every 5, self-eval every 10, context compression every 15 iterations) and persists sessions, memory and learning state to disk.

components.purpose: CLI entry point (argparse): 'start' launches TUI+proxy, 'proxy' starts the server only, '--list' enumerates saved sessions

FastAPI server (server.py) plus backend services: docker (Kali sandbox), ollama (LLM client), caido_client, fuzzer, browser, semgrep, memory (SQLite), searxng/web_search, mcp, config, correlation, reporting, filesystem

agent core (~50k LOC, ~69 modules): the agentic loop (loop*.py, loop_tool_cycle.py holds the iteration loop), tool executors (executors_*.py), models.py, output_parser.py, planning (chain_planner, pipeline), adaptive_learning, rate_limiter, validators, verification, session*, and the subagent/agent_graph multi-agent machinery
Textual TUI frontend: app.py, buddy.py, startup.py and widgets/ (chat, input, workspace, status, file_preview, path_completer)
Kali Docker sandbox definition: Dockerfile, docker-entrypoint.sh, caido-setup, settings.yml

def _normalize_args_for_dedup(
        self, tool_name: str, arguments: dict[str, Any]
    ) -> tuple[str, str]:
        args_copy = dict(arguments)
        if tool_name == "execute" and "command" in args_copy:
            cmd = args_copy["command"]
            cmd = re.sub(r"(\s+-(oA|oN|oX|oG|oJ|o)\s+[^\s]+)", "", cmd)
            cmd = re.sub(r"(\s+--output\s*=?\s*[^\s]+)", "", cmd)
            cmd = re.sub(r"(\s*>\s*[^\s]+(\s+2>&1)?)", "", cmd)
            cmd = re.sub(r"(\s+-[bc]\s+output/cookies\.txt)", "", cmd)
            cmd = re.sub(r"(\s+--cookie(?:-jar)?\s+[^\s]+)", "", cmd)
            cmd = re.sub(r"_[0-9]{8}_[0-9]{6}\.", ".", cmd)
            args_copy["command"] = cmd.strip()
